notes.tech: Thread proposed 1 (2026-11-06): cotton-nylon ripstop (ZEUVAS JACKET); washi paper weft, described as lightweight, quick-drying, breathable, UV-cut (2 styles); no trademarked fabric — NONE (no owned or licensed technical fabric; SEUVAS original alpaca and linen-check cloths are woven fabrics, not performance cloths); share of range 3 of 49 styles (6%). Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 3 (2026-11-06): Names its canvas maker (Takeyari) and a dye factory (HOWA) and places its making in Kurashiki/Kojima, with specific process notes, so at least a 3. Owned sewing factory is claimed by its own journal and (as press) Heddels but not evidenced by a filing or photo I could read, and product pages never state country or maker, so held from 4. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

cities: No store of its own in the US · its own site, and independent shops

marks: washi paper weft, described as lightweight, quick-drying, breathable, UV-cut (2 styles)

craft_evidence.owned: claimed: sewing factory in Kurashiki (brand journal, Jack Goldman story: "three-story sewing factory"); Heddels 2019 (press) says own canvas looms and factory; no photo/filing seen
craft_evidence.makers: NONE on product pages; journal names HOWA CO. (natural dye factory, Okayama) and +botao (Amakusa buttons)
craft_evidence.mills: Takeyari canvas (Concept page, est. 1888, "130 years"); product pages say only "Kurashiki canvas" (2 of 16 read)
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 16 product pages state a made-in country; 3 of 16 name Kurashiki or Okayama as fabric origin
craft_evidence.heritage: Kurashiki canvas 130+ years (Takeyari 1888); brand launched 2001 per own journal vs 2017 per disco (press); placed (Kurashiki/Kojima)
craft_evidence.process: partial: one-side seam tee, flat-seam tubular fleece, long tumbling for moleskin, botanical dyes (logwood, kakishibu, coffee, Kyoto indigo) described on product and journal pages
craft_evidence.reasoning: Names its canvas maker (Takeyari) and a dye factory (HOWA) and places its making in Kurashiki/Kojima, with specific process notes, so at least a 3. Owned sewing factory is claimed by its own journal and (as press) Heddels but not evidenced by a filing or photo I could read, and product pages never state country or maker, so held from 4.
